subject.title: fix(openai): enable prompt cache keys for Azure

question: Should Azure OpenAI Chat Completions endpoints receive prompt_cache_key and prompt_cache_retention by default after this PR is rebased onto the current package layout?
rationale: The API docs and live proof support the behavior, but this changes default wire fields for existing Azure completions users and the branch is currently unmergeable against current main.

options.title: Accept Azure Default After Rebase
options.body: Resolve the package-move conflicts, keep the explicit compat false escape hatch, and treat the live Azure proof plus Microsoft docs as sufficient for the default-on behavior.

options.title: Keep Explicit Opt-In
options.body: Do not change the default and require Azure completions users to set compat.supportsPromptCacheKey when they want stable cache keys.

options.title: Narrow The Default
options.body: Only auto-enable the fields for a smaller documented Azure endpoint/API-version subset and leave other Azure-shaped endpoints opt-in.

recommendation.title: Accept Azure Default After Rebase
recommendation.body: Resolve the package-move conflicts, keep the explicit compat false escape hatch, and treat the live Azure proof plus Microsoft docs as sufficient for the default-on behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the nearby prompt-cache compatibility gate refactor and are the best history-backed owner for the default-versus-opt-in policy choice.
